# DeployDoctor

Static deployment checks for public GitHub repositories, especially Next.js on Vercel.
Reads GitHub API files. Never clones, installs, builds or executes repository code.

- [Product](https://deploydoctor.nyttolabs.com/): public repository scan.
- [AI plugin](https://deploydoctor.nyttolabs.com/ai-plugin): tools, connection, limits, privacy and support.
- [Pricing](https://deploydoctor.nyttolabs.com/pricing): current website scan passes.
- [Source and plugin package](https://github.com/jonjys/deploydoctor): implementation and installation docs.

MCP Streamable HTTP endpoint: https://deploydoctor.nyttolabs.com/api/mcp
Tools: scan_public_repository, get_public_report, get_deploydoctor_plans.
Three free scans/day per source IP. AI clients may share that allowance.
The remote plugin does not support private repositories or paid browser sessions.
Saved reports can be partial or stale. Findings are not deployment or security guarantees.
No directory listing, AI endorsement, user count or outcome is implied.
